facts.value: Withdraw from your classes before ASU’s refund deadline. You must drop or withdraw from all your classes. Registering for classes means you agree to pay tuition and fees.
Cancel your application or admission after withdrawing from your classes by clicking the 'Cancel' button.
If you forgot your User ID or password, call the Help Desk at 480-965-6500 for help.

By canceling your application or admission, your housing assignment and financial aid (including scholarships) will also be canceled. You are still responsible for any housing or university charges you already owe.
It may take up to two weeks for ASU emails and messages to stop.
